repository.description: CarPaly — Android CarPlay receiver project with Geely Xingyue L (KX11) compatibility development.

candidate.summaryZh: 本地 v1.1.53/code 41 Release APK 已通过 APK 结构、包名/版本、签名、SHA-256 与认证资源匹配检查。签名证书 SHA-256 为 d9b329525fc1ef21c365fab72c10367527cc038297c4f30eaa22b2207429139e，APK SHA-256 为 01212c62442b80f61d9fb9238f868d4f476bf460ededabb99ee038367dc9ed27。该新签名与 v1.1.52 不同，不能覆盖旧安装，仅适用于全新安装；尚未实车测试，也没有 GitHub 标签或公开 Release。不得据此宣称实车 CarPlay、音频或显示问题已修复。
candidate.summaryEn: The local v1.1.53/code 41 Release APK passed APK structure, package/version, signature, SHA-256, and authentication-asset matching checks. Signer certificate SHA-256: d9b329525fc1ef21c365fab72c10367527cc038297c4f30eaa22b2207429139e. APK SHA-256: 01212c62442b80f61d9fb9238f868d4f476bf460ededabb99ee038367dc9ed27. This signer differs from v1.1.52 and cannot update that install in place; it is suitable only for a fresh install. No vehicle test, GitHub tag, or public Release exists. No in-vehicle CarPlay, audio, or display fix is claimed.
releaseNotesZh: 本地 Release APK 已生成并通过结构、版本、签名、哈希与认证资源匹配检查；APK SHA-256：01212c62442b80f61d9fb9238f868d4f476bf460ededabb99ee038367dc9ed27。
本版本切换到新的 Android Release 签名，不能覆盖安装 v1.1.52 或更早旧签名版本；不要为测试而卸载现有版本。
仅限尚未安装 CarPaly 的测试设备全新安装；本 APK 尚未实际安装验收、未完成实车测试，也没有公开发布。
不得据此宣称音乐自动暂停、导航无声或顶部状态栏遮挡问题已修复。
HUD、仪表、燃油及其他未经实际验证的车辆功能保持 NOT_TESTED。
releaseNotesEn: The local Release APK passed structure, version, signature, hash, and authentication-asset matching checks. APK SHA-256: 01212c62442b80f61d9fb9238f868d4f476bf460ededabb99ee038367dc9ed27.
This build uses a new Android Release signer and cannot update v1.1.52 or earlier legacy-signed installs in place. Do not uninstall an existing copy just to test it.
For fresh installation only on a device without CarPaly. The APK has not been installation-tested, vehicle-tested, or publicly released.
Do not claim that media auto-pause, silent navigation prompts, or OEM status-bar overlap is fixed.
HUD, instrument cluster, fuel data, and other unverified vehicle features remain NOT_TESTED.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈连接正常；测试 APK 版本、车型配置及有线/无线模式未记录，维护者未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported a normal connection; APK version, vehicle trim, and wired/wireless mode were not recorded and have not been independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈音乐播放约一秒后自动暂停；唤醒 Siri 时音乐可播放。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported that music pauses after about one second, while playback works when Siri is active.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈导航提示音无声；根因及修复状态尚未由本轮新实车复测确认。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported silent navigation prompts; the root cause and any fix have not been confirmed by a new vehicle retest.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈可听见 Siri 且 Siri 能听见用户；未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported hearing Siri and being heard by Siri; not independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈按键有响应；具体按键与映射未记录，未独立复现。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported responsive keys; individual keys and mappings were not recorded and have not been independently reproduced.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 用户反馈仍遮挡 CarPlay 画面。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: User reported that the OEM status bar still overlaps the CarPlay view.

vehicleFeedback.detailZh: 没有可核实的实车接口调用或验收证据。
vehicleFeedback.detailEn: No verifiable in-vehicle interface call or acceptance evidence is available.
